newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Aug CPI rises 0.2 pct mo/mo, 9.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech Aug CPI rises 0.2 pct mo/mo, 9.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech consumer prices rose 0.2 percent in August, putting prices 9.6 percent higher than in the same month of last year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
CZECH CONSUMER INFLATION Aug 96 July 96 Aug 95
Note. Basket of goods and services is unchanged from 1995.

The Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday the main impetus for inflation in August was housing, the cost of which rose 3.2 percent in the month. However, the price of food, tobacco and drink had fallen 1.4 percent.
Housing price rises were affected by a 15.2 percent administrative increase in the regulated price of natural gas and a 14.8 percent rise in electricity prices.
AUG CPI BASKET COMPONENTS CHANGE MO/MO CHANGE YR/YR

Note. July basket component changes in brackets. All changes are rises except when stated. Prices have risen 20.0 percent from the average level for 1994 while August's sliding average using a 1993 base was 8.6 percent.
